Cartas invertidas: cómo se interpretan: Reversed cards: how to interpret them
En la tradición del tarot, una carta pue: In tarot tradition, a card can appear upright or reversed (with the image upside down). There are several ways to read it. For some readers, a reversal blocks or weakens the card's energy; for others, it shows that energy in an inward or less visible form. And some readers don't use reversals at all. There's no single rule, and all of them are symbolic conventions. If you're just starting out, a good practice is to read the card in its main meaning first and treat the reversal as a nuance, not as an "opposite meaning."
Cómo formular una buena pregunta: How to ask a good question
La calidad de la lectura depende mucho d: The quality of a reading depends a lot on the question. Some simple guidelines: phrase it positively and in the first person, ask about what's within your control, and avoid questions about other people or exact dates. Compare "Will they text me again?" with "What do I need to understand about how I feel in this relationship?" The second opens up reflection; the first demands a prediction that tarot, as a symbolic language, can't offer.
